answer: The lotus panel is drawn blind, the ridge escrow settles at close, and sable lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 12% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 405 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
